author: Steve Mould
description:
Click this link: https://hensonshaving.com/stevemould and use code STEVEMOULD to recieve 100 free blades with the purchase of your AL13 razor.

Turning a drum full of grains of different sizes sorts the grins by size and forms weird patterns. It's linked to granular segregation, the Brazil nut effect and landslides on the moon.

Here's the paper by Chris and Nico: https://www.researchgate.net/publication/377489269_Particle-size_segregation_patterns_in_a_partially_filled_triangular_rotating_drum

Here's the colloidal phase separation paper: https://pubs.acs.org/langd5/article-abstract/26/5/3174/306151/The-Role-of-Polymer-Polydispersity-in-Phase
